name: Dialog

requiredCapabilities: controlled open/onClose, modal isolation, focus management and focus return
Escape/backdrop dismissal, accessible title/description and native dialog ref API
AISEE backdrop, entry/exit timing, layout variants and reduced-motion behavior

preserve: Preserve native modal focus handling, Escape/close callbacks, responsive layouts and entry/exit/backdrop motion.
Preserve AISEE visual layout, scoped styles, states, icons, animation timing, interactions and accessibility when adapting host primitives; host default styling must not replace them.
